description: Repo-level maintainer report: what needs attention across the whole repo? Reports PR races (two or more open PRs fixing the same issue, with first-claim arbitration), claimed-by-other conflicts (an open PR whose linked issue was claimed by someone else first), stale claims (issues claimed 14+ days ago with no open PR), and assignment-gate conflicts (repos that require assignment before a PR). Pass a --limit to bound the API budget on large repos; sections that cannot be computed say so instead of showing empty. Call this when triaging a repo, not just one PR.

limit.description: Max open PRs and open issues to inspect. The summary always states the cap and the true totals.

name: repo_digest
